commit.message: fix(mike): required cloud review quorum is codex; copilot accepted but never required [impact-checked]

intent: Remove copilot from the required cloud review quorum in the automerge/backlog lanes per operator ratification 2026-07-31 (copilot credits burn fast and reviews are unreliable: zero copilot reviews repo-wide kept the receipt gate permanently unclearable). Required cloud receipt becomes codex (native App review at the exact current head); copilot reviews remain ACCEPTED additively via TRUSTED_REVIEW_LOGINS but are never required. Witness receipt: ~/.dharma/witness/merge_approval/ratification_20260731_repo_wide_automerge.md

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import re, sys; texts = [Path('.github/workflows/codex-mention-router.yml').read_text(), Path('.github/workflows/merge-master-mike-backlog.yml').read_text()]; bad = [line for text in texts for line in text.splitlines() if ('REQUIRED_REVIEWERS' in line or 'default:' in line) and 'copilot' in line]; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

honest_blockers: codex reviews still go stale on every rebase; a single-agent required quorum makes the fresh-final-head receipt (codex re-review or local fanout) the sole receipt path for human PRs in the cloud lane.
This packet does not change DEFAULT_REQUIRED_REVIEWERS (codex,claude) for the local lane, TRUSTED_REVIEW_LOGINS, or any gate logic.
